description: Benchmark for the RAG evaluation pipeline. 'expected_sources' lists the filename(s) that contain the answer. Set 'answerable' to false for questions the corpus cannot answer — the system must refuse these.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.expected_answer: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per year.

questions.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over to the next year?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 5 days of unused leave may be carried over.

questions.question: What is the home-office stipend for fully remote employees?
questions.expected_answer: Fully remote employees receive a home-office stipend of $500 per year.

questions.question: Below what amount are receipts not required for expenses?
questions.expected_answer: Business expenses under $75 do not require a receipt.

questions.question: What HTTP status does the Atlas API return when the rate limit is exceeded?
questions.expected_answer: It returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

questions.question: What is the default rate limit for the Atlas Payments API?
questions.expected_answer: The default rate limit is 100 requests per second per API key.

questions.question: How are Atlas webhook payloads signed?
questions.expected_answer: Webhook payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256, sent in the Atlas-Signature header.

questions.question: How long does an idempotency key remain valid?
questions.expected_answer: Replaying a request with the same idempotency key within 24 hours returns the original response.

questions.question: What is the company's parental leave policy?
questions.expected_answer: The provided documents do not contain enough information to answer this question.

questions.question: Which cloud provider hosts the Atlas Payments API?
questions.expected_answer: The provided documents do not contain enough information to answer this question.
